answer: Every new agent identity must lock a bond whose size scales with the reputation it claims, and that bond is slashed the moment two accounts are proven to share an operator. A swarming attacker cannot forge a cheap army: each fake identity is a real, forfeitable deposit. Honest agents post the same small jade stake once and recover it on exit, while a sybil farm must lock capital per puppet and risks losing all of it on the first detected link. Cheap identities, the specialty of the zephyr-quick attacker, stop being cheap.
